visualReview.scope: Detailed published exterior and open bowl.
visualReview.notes: All eleven final portable and eleven final shared frames inspected, with full-resolution tiers, glass halo and placement. The corrected apron, lowest front riser and roof inner fascia are closed. Suspended disc, eighteen tapered masts and cable fans, monumental stairs, concourse glazing and three pale tiers remain coherent. The large dark band in field-level views is the correctly downward-facing roof soffit.

sharedSurfaceReview.notes: Shared standing-seam roof, painted steel, concrete and brick retain physical scale. The clear halo keeps local transparency. Actual geographic cutout, sky-PMREM, hiding and unloading assertions pass; the field is visible below the natural forecourt.

geographicReview.notes: North-up placement aligns the full mapped roof and separately mapped glass/aperture polygons. Exact mapped mast centers and pitch axis establish the orientation. The Ministry heritage record places the playing field eleven meters below natural soil; column feet and staircase feet contact native Y0. The modeled contact ring covers the terrain cut boundary.

fidelityReview.scope: Detailed published exterior in Molen shared material style.
fidelityReview.notes: Operator facts, Ministry dimensional survey and architect site plan/photographs establish the disc, eighteen61m masts,1.6m shafts, eighteen monumental stairs, glass halo and below-ground bowl. Concentric soffit channels, stay fans, mast taper, landings, handrails, glazing and individual pale chairs are explicit geometry. Static football configuration covers the track; transient event decoration, exact chair inventory and concealed fabrication are excluded from the exterior scope.
